html:
sustainability 
made clear

Integrity has always been ingrained in everything we do as clear as the capsules our ingredients come in. The same honesty now guides how we treat the planet, our people and the seas our collagen comes from.

To help people age better with clinically proven nutrition designed for real absorption using responsibly sourced ingredients and lower-waste formats.

ANIMAL
WELFARE

Our marine collagen is sourced from free-swimming, sustainably caught fish adhering to the highest standards of animal welfare and environmental responsibility. We follow best practices in animal welfare throughout our supply chain, ensuring humane fishing methods, minimal stress, and no harm to marine life.

We are committed to ethical methods that respect marine ecosystems, promote biodiversity, and prioritise sustainability at every stage, from sourcing to production.

Our belief
in b corp

Our belief
in b corp

We believe a company should be measured by more than its margins. That's why we are certified B Corp, a rigorous, independent assessment of our impact on people, community and planet. It's not a badge we expect to be handed; it's a standard we're choosing to be held to.

Certification helps keep us accountable, gives our customers an independent measure of our impact, and turns our values into something transparent and verifiable.

conserving

From the seas our collagen comes from to the box on your doorstep, conserving is our promise to protect natural resources at every stage sourcing, packaging and climate.

Ethical Ingredient Sourcing

Our marine collagen is sustainably sourced from free-swimming fish, while our natural astaxanthin is grown in a carbon-negative system. From source to capsule, we prioritise ingredients that protect marine ecosystems and support biodiversity through responsible sourcing.

Sustainable Packaging

Premium shouldn't mean wasteful. We've redesigned our packaging to be recyclable and continue to simplify materials and make considered choices across our supply chain. By balancing product protection with environmental impact, we're reducing waste without compromising customer experience.

Climate Action

You can't reduce what you haven't measured. We're assessing our emissions, setting reduction targets and building a climate transition plan that supports the global goal of net zero by 2050, while supporting UK charities that help people live healthier, more active lives.

We go beyond the predictability of the industry to set our own standards

PEOPLE
PURPOSE
& IMPACT

Charity

We channel a portion of what we make into causes that mirror our purpose: health and ageing well. Our giving is intentional rather than transactional: long-term partnerships where we contribute funding, product and our team's expertise, and report openly on the difference it makes. Because doing well and doing good were never meant to be separate.

Human Rights

From the fisheries that supply our collagen to the partners who manufacture our capsules, we expect and verify that every person is treated with dignity. That means safe conditions, fair pay, no forced or child labour, and the freedom to raise concerns. We map our supply chain, hold partners to a clear code of conduct, and act when standards fall short.

Jedi: Justice, Equity, Diversity & Inclusion

At Ingenious we believe good businesses are built through fair treatment, diverse perspectives, responsible decision-making and an inclusive culture. We are committed to creating a working environment where people are treated with respect, valued for their contribution and able to develop regardless of background, identity or circumstance. This commitment applies across how we operate as a business, how we work with customers and partners, and how we engage with the wider community.

We aim to:

  • Make recruitment, development and progression decisions fairly and consistently
  • Encourage different perspectives and constructive challenge
  • Maintain policies and practices that support inclusion, wellbeing and equal opportunity
  • Communicate with customers in a clear, respectful and responsible way
  • Work with suppliers and partners who operate responsibly and ethically
  • Continue reviewing and improving our approach as the business grows

Responsibility for this commitment sits with the leadership team and forms part of the company’s wider governance and operational approach.
